lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: What is the penalty under Texas law for illegally parking in a disabled space without a valid placard?

options.text: A verbal administrative warning with zero financial municipal consequences
Class C misdemeanor with fines up to $1,250 and community service requirements
Immediate permanent revocation of the violator's motor vehicle license tags
Confiscation of personal property inside the unlawfully parked vehicle
